name: freelancer-marketplace
description: Full-Stack Freelancer Marketplace & Portfolio Directory with Supabase PostgreSQL, React 19, Express, and Socket.IO

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
